# Appointly Solutions

> Appointly Solutions is a pay per appointment Meta ads agency that books estimates for garage floor coating and concrete coating contractors. We run the Meta (Facebook and Instagram) campaigns from our own ad account, contact every homeowner lead within minutes, qualify them, and book the estimate directly onto the contractor's calendar. We work with one floor coating contractor per market. Founded by brothers Patrick and Jacob Mietka in Chicago, IL. Serving the US and Canada.

Specialty: floor coating contractors, exclusively. Garage floors, epoxy, polyaspartic, and concrete coatings are the only trade we work in, and the only work our creative, qualifying criteria, and booking scripts are built around. We do not take on contractors in other trades.

Who it is for: garage floor coating, epoxy, polyaspartic, and concrete coating contractors who want booked estimates instead of raw leads. Small and mid-sized markets are a specialty.

What we deliver: exclusive, booked, confirmed estimate appointments with homeowners in the contractor's service area. Not shared leads, not form fills.

Key facts:

- Pricing: $125 to $199 per booked estimate, depending on market and the work installed. No retainer, no monthly fee, nothing charged for leads that never book.
- Exclusivity: one floor coating contractor per market. Appointments are never shared, resold, or split.
- Ad account: Appointly runs the campaigns from its own Meta ad account and Business Manager. The contractor never creates an account, shares logins, or manages a campaign.
- No-shows: credited, as are appointments that do not meet the qualification criteria agreed at the start.
- Qualification: the homeowner owns the property, wants floor coating work, is inside the service area, and has agreed to a time that fits the contractor's route.

- [Floor coating leads, booked as estimates](https://getappointly.co/floor-coating-leads): the main service page.
- [Case studies](https://getappointly.co/case-studies): three floor coating clients, framed as monthly results so far, with close rates, average job sizes, and the clients' actual estimate calendars. Clean Floor Coatings (Myrtle Beach, SC): about 70% of shown appointments close in a crowded market. AFAB Services (Port St. Lucie, FL): about 50% close rate at a $3,500 average job, roughly $35,000 closed in his best month. Garage Force of the Inland Northwest (Spokane, WA): about 55% close rate on a premium $5,000 polyurea system.
